description: Mask editing UI, host adapters (loader, saver, image widget, dialog, brush persistence), and the core extension contract. The @comfyorg/mask-editor package holds the stroke, GPU, pan/zoom, canvas-history and tool-manager engine.

characterizationScenarios.name: Drawing operations preserve brush and canvas-history behavior
Loading and saving preserve image-layer and widget boundaries
Mask PNG encoding round-trips through the decoder fixture
Core extensions register the clipspace and mask editor and open the editor from node menus
Clipspace copies and pastes node images
Pan and zoom math keeps the point under the cursor and clamps the zoom
The stroke engine and editor store keep their contract for the painter and undo commands

compatibilityPromises: The core extension remains the host integration seam for opening the editor.
Image widget values and layer output remain covered by loader and saver characterization tests.
